layer_3_action.subject: Bright mid-day view of a semi-arid seasonal floodplain
features: A wide, mostly dry riverbed of pale gravel and light-colored silt
Isolated, sparkling blue pools of water remaining in deep bends
Resilient, vertical horsetails (Equisetum) clustered near water
Deep-rooted conifer shrubs and hardy ferns on the higher banks
Strong mid-day sunlight reflecting off the pale stones
layer_3_action.action: A bright, sun-soaked view of a dry river system. The 'green' is concentrated along the dry channel edges. The ground is textured with pebbles and hardy prehistoric plants. No grass.

visuals.ground: Pale river gravel and sun-bleached silt. The vegetation consists of tough, scrubby ferns and specialized mosses that survive dry spells. No grass.
visuals.water: Small, crystal-clear pools reflecting the deep blue sky, acting as focal points in the dry landscape.
visuals.sky: Clear, vibrant blue with high visibility.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Smooth water-worn gravel, sun-bleached silt, and tough plant fibers.
